collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was collected

repositories_present.description: Whether the scan covered any repositories. When false, the branch protection percentages are null
repositories_present.x-epack-summary: Whether any repositories were included in the scan.

repository_count.description: Repositories in the organization that the include and exclude patterns could select
repository_count.x-epack-summary: Repositories in the organization that could be included in the scan.

scanned_repository_count.description: Repositories the scan covered. The branch protection percentages count these

repo_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of repositories covered by the scan (based on include/exclude patterns)
repo_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of the organization's repositories included in the scan.

branch_protection.description: Coverage percentages for branch protection rules on default branches
branch_protection.x-epack-summary: Review and protection rules on each scanned repository's default branch.

pr_required_repository_count.description: Scanned repositories requiring pull requests before merge
pr_required_repository_count.x-epack-summary: Scanned repositories whose default branch requires a pull request before merge.

approving_reviews_repository_count.description: Scanned repositories requiring at least one approving review
approving_reviews_repository_count.x-epack-summary: Scanned repositories whose default branch requires at least one approving review before merge.

status_checks_repository_count.description: Scanned repositories requiring status checks to pass
status_checks_repository_count.x-epack-summary: Scanned repositories whose default branch requires status checks to pass before merge.

signed_commits_repository_count.x-epack-summary: Scanned repositories whose default branch requires signed commits.

pr_required_pct.description: Percentage of repos requiring pull requests before merge
pr_required_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of scanned repositories whose default branch requires a pull request before merge.

approving_reviews_pct.description: Percentage of repos requiring at least one approving review
approving_reviews_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of scanned repositories whose default branch requires at least one approving review before merge.

status_checks_pct.description: Percentage of repos requiring status checks to pass
status_checks_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of scanned repositories whose default branch requires status checks to pass before merge.

signed_commits_pct.description: Percentage of repos requiring signed commits
signed_commits_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of scanned repositories whose default branch requires signed commits.
